_comment: The one canonical grouping of the 12 modalities into families, read by src/analytics/families.py and frontend/src/lib/modalityFamilies.ts. It replaced five divergent copies (progression_tracker._MODALITY_FAMILIES, summary.py, api._week_volume, sessionAnalysis.ts), two of which named modalities that do not exist and all of which dropped combat_sport and rehab. This is a display/rollup grouping; data/matching_rules.json `families` is a *similarity* grouping under a cross-language parity contract and is deliberately separate.
